data.gender_notes: Hammer is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hammer is derived from the Old English word 'hamor', meaning 'a heavy striking tool'. The name carries the connotation of strength, power, and the ability to shape or break things. The name Hammer carries the meaning “Tool, weapon” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Hammer usually hope their child will grow to embody tool, weapon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In spiritual terms, the name Hammer represents the power of God to shape and mold our lives, and the strength we need to overcome challenges and obstacles.
data.etymology: Hammer belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tool, weapon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hammer total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
